title: S78 — Screen Solver: native overlay app — click-calibrate captcha + text box, read, auto-paste (Director priority-1)
desc: GOAL: the app Carlo actually asked for — a NATIVE desktop overlay (not a browser tab): user clicks to calibrate (a) the captcha image region and (b) the text-box region; the app captures the captcha region from the LIVE screen, reads it with the shipping reader (reader_lex route: baseline.read_text + lex_projection.fix_line), cleans the text, and types/pastes it into the text box automatically. WHY: W2 #82 screen-read mode is browser-bound (getDisplayMedia), read-only, and cannot reach another window's text box — read vs solve gap. DELIVERABLE: apps/qcaptcha/ {capture, input-injection, engine bridge, tkinter overlay UI, launcher} + tools/build_solver_zip.py (self-contained bundle incl. models + fonts; carries W2 #82's bundled-fonts generator fix) + tests (headless + GUI-under-Xvfb end-to-end with xdotool). EVIDENCE: selftest receipt, end-to-end test log (screen→read→typed text verified in a widget), honest limits (in-distribution DejaVu only; 98/95 NOT met; screen-picker permissions per OS). BOUNDARIES: no reader-path edits; no tuning on canonical seeds; captchaproject(s) off-limits; honest numbers only. OWNER: argus (Director priority-1).
